description: X1 phase-2 full training: 330-clip multi-activity library (walk/jog/run/turn/dance, arm fix baked into the retarget pipeline), 60k iterations on 1x4090D. Budget mapping in docs/X1_PHASE2_DATASET.md: 0.55 s/iter measured on TASK_20261102_068 -> 60k it ~ 9.2 h ~ Y53, wall_hours 10 caps it under Y58. eval_every_hours 2 gives ~5 in-sample EVAL points; stop-early criterion (two consecutive EVALs with 0 failed and norm_return >= 0.90) is evaluated offline from eval.jsonl, the run itself is capped by wall_hours. Same deviations from --preset recommended as phase 1 (compile off, bptt_checkpoint 1): both were proven on TASK_20261102_068 on this SKU.
